title: rorippa palustris var. pacifica
intro: Rorippa palustris var. pacifica, commonly known as Western watercress, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is a nutrient-rich food source, providing numerous health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Western watercress include its ability to support digestive health, boost the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-cancer properties. Its bioactive constituents include glucosinolates, isothiocyanates, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal and nutritional value.
